name: Nonprofit / NGO Organization
description: Mission-driven organization structure for nonprofits, NGOs, and charitable foundations. Executive Director leads with program directors managing thematic or geographic initiatives. Development/fundraising team is revenue engine. Designed for organizations focused on social, environmental, or humanitarian impact.

org_structure.overview: Nonprofits are mission-driven organizations where every role connects back to the organization's social or environmental purpose. The revenue engine (development/fundraising) exists to fund programs, not generate profit. Board of Directors provides fiduciary oversight. Funding is typically grants, individual donations, corporate sponsorships, and earned revenue. Organizational culture centers on mission alignment, volunteer engagement, and measurable impact outcomes. Smaller organizations collapse multiple roles into the Executive Office and rely heavily on volunteers and part-time staff. Growth-stage nonprofits professionalize their Development team and add M&E (Monitoring & Evaluation) functions to satisfy major institutional donors.

roles.title: Executive Director
roles.description: Sets vision, leads fundraising strategy, manages board relations, represents organization externally to media, government, and major partners.

roles.title: Deputy Director
roles.description: Oversees day-to-day operations, coordinates across departments, ensures program goals are met, and manages crisis response.

roles.title: Chief of Staff
roles.description: Manages board communications, executive scheduling, strategic planning processes, and cross-department initiatives.

roles.title: Director of Development
roles.description: Leads fundraising strategy, cultivates major donors, manages development team, and sets annual revenue targets across all channels.

roles.title: Grant Writer
roles.description: Researches and writes grant proposals, manages grant calendar and compliance, and cultivates foundation relationships.

roles.title: Major Gifts Officer
roles.description: Cultivates and solicits major donors ($10K+), manages donor portfolios, and designs stewardship plans.

roles.title: Annual Giving Manager
roles.description: Manages direct mail, email appeals, monthly giving programs, and donor acquisition campaigns.

roles.title: Corporate Partnerships Manager
roles.description: Develops and manages corporate sponsorship relationships, cause marketing campaigns, and workplace giving programs.

roles.title: Donor Database Administrator
roles.description: Manages CRM (Salesforce, Raiser's Edge), donor records, gift processing, reconciliation, and reporting.

roles.title: Program Director
roles.description: Leads a program area (e.g. Education, Health, Environment), designs strategy, manages program managers, and ensures measurable outcomes.

roles.title: Program Manager
roles.description: Manages specific initiatives, coordinates field staff, tracks metrics and deliverables, and reports to funders.

roles.title: Field Staff / Community Coordinator
roles.description: Delivers direct services to beneficiaries, coordinates with community partners, collects program data, and provides feedback for program improvement.

roles.title: Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) Officer
roles.description: Designs M&E frameworks, collects and analyzes program data, prepares impact reports, and ensures evidence-based program adaptations.

roles.title: Director of Advocacy
roles.description: Leads policy agenda, government relations, coalition building, and public policy positions.

roles.title: Policy Analyst
roles.description: Researches policy issues, drafts position papers, analyzes legislation, and prepares briefs for policymakers.

roles.title: Community Organizer
roles.description: Mobilizes grassroots supporters, organizes events and campaigns, trains volunteer advocates, and builds coalitions.

roles.title: Communications Director
roles.description: Leads communications strategy, brand management, media relations, and crisis communications.

roles.title: Digital Marketing Manager
roles.description: Manages social media, email campaigns, website content, SEO, and digital advertising.

roles.title: Content Writer / Storyteller
roles.description: Produces impact stories, newsletters, annual reports, donor communications, and multimedia content.

roles.title: Finance Director / Controller
roles.description: Oversees financial operations, grant compliance, annual audit, board financial reporting, and internal controls.

roles.title: Grants Manager
roles.description: Tracks grant budgets, ensures funder compliance, prepares financial reports for donors, and manages grant closeout.

roles.title: Staff Accountant
roles.description: AP/AR, bank reconciliations, payroll support, and month-end close.

roles.title: HR Manager
roles.description: Manages recruitment, onboarding, benefits administration, employee relations, and HR compliance.

roles.title: Volunteer Coordinator
roles.description: Recruits, trains, schedules, and manages volunteers; ensures volunteer engagement and retention.

key_relationships: Program and Development must be tightly aligned — programs provide impact stories that fuel fundraising, and funder requirements shape program design
Finance works with Programs to ensure grant compliance, accurate spending, and timely reporting to donors
Advocacy and Communications partner closely — policy wins need public visibility, and communications supports advocacy campaigns
M&E Officer provides evidence that both Programs (for improvement) and Development (for donor reporting) rely on
Board provides fiduciary oversight and often includes key donors who open doors to new funding sources
Volunteer Coordinator partners with all departments to deploy volunteers effectively across programs and events
Executive Director personally manages the top 10-20 donor relationships and board member cultivation
org_structure.org_chart_text:
Board of Directors
└── Executive Director
    ├── Deputy Director
    │   ├── Program Director(s)
    │   │   ├── Program Managers
    │   │   ├── Field Staff / Community Coordinators
    │   │   └── M&E Officer
    │   └── HR Manager
    │       └── Volunteer Coordinator
    ├── Director of Development
    │   ├── Grant Writer
    │   ├── Major Gifts Officer
    │   ├── Annual Giving Manager
    │   ├── Corporate Partnerships Manager
    │   └── Donor Database Admin
    ├── Director of Advocacy
    │   ├── Policy Analyst
    │   └── Community Organizer
    ├── Communications Director
    │   ├── Digital Marketing Manager
    │   └── Content Writer / Storyteller
    ├── Finance Director / Controller
    │   ├── Grants Manager
    │   └── Staff Accountant
    └── Chief of Staff (optional)

traits: High empathy and emotional intelligence required
Resource-constrained creativity is a core competency
Volunteer engagement is part of everyone's role
Burnout risk is elevated — mission passion can mask overwork
challenges: Funding volatility creates boom/bust hiring cycles
Passion can mask underinvestment in systems and infrastructure
Board governance varies widely in sophistication
Measuring impact rigorously while resources are limited
best_practices: Invest in donor CRM early — it pays for itself
Diversify funding across grants, individuals, earned revenue
Professionalize HR as soon as headcount exceeds 20
Create clear boundaries to prevent mission-driven burnout
